metadata.title: Kinematics of hypervelocity stars in the triaxial halo of the Milky Way

notes: No eligible individual stars are identifiable. The paper is a theoretical study of simulated HVS populations: it integrates HVS orbits numerically (T:p3-b28) and assumes 10^4 HVSs ejected over the last 10^9 yr (T:p4-b5), without supplying individual stellar identifiers. The one individually highlighted simulated star in Fig. 3 is an unnamed bound star (T:p6-b1) and therefore is not a Galactic-unbound candidate. The observational reference is likewise to a population, including “possibly bound HVSs” observed by Brown et al. (2007), not to individually identified stars (T:p8-b6).
